description: SLICE 3: the INVERSE (the 'vice versa') + the conservation law, on top of slices 1-2. (A) LIFT = single-view inverse projection (PERCEPTION): a Sample(u,v,appearance) under an INPUT viewpoint mints Loci in the held N-D structure, the COLLAPSED ray coord recovered from a graph-resident ExtrudePrior (appearance_class -> set of ray heights). PROJECT/LIFT cannot loop: a Viewpoint carries vp_mode (0=output,1=input); project_sample fires ONLY on output vps, lift ONLY on input vps; per-vp Samples keep the two sets disjoint. (B) CONSERVED-MEMBERSHIP: a change is REAL only if the HELD STRUCTURE changes (Locus appears, appearance attr changes, or comprises-membership flips); a projection re-read after the viewpoint moved mints NO agency signal. DEFERRED to slice 4: multi-view parallax LIFT, ls20 enclosure inference, StructureDelta -> respond_vote rewire. | SLICE 5: PERSPECTIVE projection kind (u=f*(X-px)/Z, occlusion still nearest-along-ray) + parallax_lift (depth-from-motion: Z=f*(px1-px2)/(u2-u1) from two perspective INPUT viewpoints + the two Samples of one corresponded Feature; no prior; guards d==0; loop-free; idempotent). Angular/trig raycast triangulation deferred (needs a trig primitive).

microtheory.name: projection
microtheory.description: hold the world once (Loci on Axes). PROJECT (imagination) renders to an OUTPUT viewpoint: nearest-along-ray=MinOver. LIFT (perception) reconstructs from EXTERNALLY-GIVEN Samples on an INPUT viewpoint: u/v fixed by the vp's u/v axes; the ray axis is recovered per-appearance by the ExtrudePrior (wall->full column, floor->single locus). PROJECT o LIFT ~= identity on the observed region. A change is real only when the held Loci change.

concepts.name: screen_u
concepts.comment: u(locus|vp). Unchanged from slice 2 — LIFT mints Coords carrying proj_role + an `on` edge so this reader works on recovered Loci identically.

concepts.name: ray_depth
concepts.comment: ray(locus|vp). Unchanged from slice 2. LIFT mints the recovered ray Coord on the input vp's ray axis (height), so this reads it back.

concepts.name: proj_depth
concepts.comment: DEPTH for occlusion, kind aware (slice 6). raycast==1 -> euclidean range sqrt((X-px)^2+(Y-py)^2) (near hides far at same bearing); else == ray_depth so ortho/persp occlusion unchanged. project_sample folds this instead of ray_depth.

concepts.name: region_is_ground
concepts.comment: STRUCTURAL ground = the largest Region by member count (colour-blind). x=region, y=game. The ls20 floor is uniquely the max; ties would read both as ground (acceptable here).

concepts.name: proj_u
concepts.comment: PROJECTED screen-u, kind aware (slice 6). raycast==1 -> BEARING atan2(Y-py,X-px)-yaw (X=screen_u/role0, Y=screen_v/role1); else slice-5 persp pinhole / ortho identity. Kinds disjoint via absent-attr fall-through.

concepts.name: proj_v
concepts.comment: PROJECTED screen-v, kind aware (slice 6). raycast==1 -> constant 0 (1-D screen) so same-(u,v) column = same-BEARING; else slice-5 / ortho.

rules.name: projection_bootstrap
rules.comment: FRAME 0 ONLY, idempotent. Axes (proj_role 0=row=u,1=col=v,2=depth,3=height). THREE Viewpoints: OUTPUT ortho_topdown(vp_id 0,ray=depth) + ortho_map(vp_id 1,ray=height); INPUT map_in(vp_id 2,ray=height,vp_mode 1) — LIFT consumes Samples placed here. EXTRUDE PRIOR (ls20, self-subsettable): 'wall' -> ray {0,1,2} (full column), 'floor' -> ray {0} (single); one ExtrudePrior per (appearance_class,h). add_node_if_absent/add_edge dedup; anchored on has_cell to bind `game`.

rules.name: project_sample
rules.comment: THE PROJECT FOLD (occlusion = nearest-along-ray), viewpoint-relative. SLICE-3 GATE: added And clause Eq(vp.vp_mode,0) restricts firing to OUTPUT viewpoints -> PROJECT never re-reads the Samples LIFT consumes -> no PROJECT/LIFT oscillation. Argmin guard unchanged. sid = vp_id*1e8+u*1e4+v carries the viewpoint. Fixpoint-idempotent + self-terminating. | SLICE 6: occlusion fold reads proj_depth (kind-aware) not ray_depth -> raycast occludes by min euclidean range; ortho/persp unchanged (proj_depth==ray_depth there).

rules.name: lift
rules.comment: SLICE 3-A: INVERSE PROJECTION = PERCEPTION. For each INPUT viewpoint (vp_mode 1), each Sample on it, and each ExtrudePrior whose appearance_class == Sample.appearance, mint ONE Locus. ua/va (screen_u/v_axis) fix u,v = Sample.u/v; ra (ray_axis = height) is the COLLAPSED coord recovered as prior.h. 'wall' (3 priors) -> full-height column of 3 Loci; 'floor' (1 prior) -> single Locus at ray 0. Locus deduped on lid=u*1e4+v*1e2+h; Coords deduped on (value,proj_role) and wired `on`->Axis so slice-1/2 readers work unchanged. LOOP-FREE: gate Eq(vp.vp_mode,1); recovered Loci re-project only via project_sample on OUTPUT vps -> the two never feed each other. Fixpoint-idempotent + self-terminating. ROUND-TRIP: 3D -> project (output map vp) -> floor-plan Samples -> copy onto input vp -> lift -> wall footprints regain ray {0,1,2}; re-projecting reproduces the plan.

rules.name: parallax_lift
rules.comment: SLICE 5: DEPTH-FROM-MOTION. Two perspective INPUT viewpoints (vp_mode 1, persp 1) and the two Samples of ONE corresponded Feature (s1 -of_feature-> f <- of_feature- s2) triangulate the feature: Z = focal*(px1-px2)/(u2-u1), X = px1 + u1*Z/focal (pinhole, pure Div/Minus/Times, NO prior, NO trig). Mints add_node_if_absent(Locus) at the recovered (X on lateral role-0 axis, Z on ray/depth role-2 axis) with the Feature's appearance; Coords carry proj_role + `on`->Axis so screen_u/ray_depth read it back. ORDER+DISTINCT guard Lt(vp2.vp_id, vp1.vp_id) (one binding per feature-pair, no self-match); DEGENERATE guard Not(Eq(u2-u1,0)) (feature at infinity / no parallax -> no mint, and dodges the Div-by-0 that returns 0). LOOP-FREE: gated to input vps, never writes a Sample on an input vp -> never re-consumes its own Locus; project_sample (output vps) may re-project it, different rule, no cycle. IDEMPOTENT: lid = X*1e6 + Z recomputed deterministically -> add_node_if_absent/add_edge/set_attr all no-op at fixpoint. Axes latax(role0)/rayax(role2) come from projection_bootstrap (frame 0, persistent).

rules.name: raycast_triangulate
rules.comment: SLICE 6: ANGULAR TRIANGULATION LIFT (true Doom/Quake depth-from-motion; subsumes slice-5 pinhole as its small-angle limit). Two raycast INPUT vps (vp_mode 1, raycast 1) at known poses + the two Samples of ONE Feature (of_feature). Sample.u IS the bearing b_i; th_i = yaw_i + b_i; intersect rays: t1 = ((px2-px1)*sin th2 - (py2-py1)*cos th2)/sin(th2-th1); X = px1 + t1*cos th1; Y = py1 + t1*sin th1. Mints Locus at (X role0, Y role1) + recovered_from->f + appearance; Coords on/proj_role so screen_u/screen_v read it back. GUARDS: Lt(vp2.vp_id,vp1.vp_id); Gt(Abs(sin(th2-th1)),1e-6) (near-parallel rays / collinear feature -> no mint, dodges Div-by-0). LOOP-FREE (input vps, no Sample written on them). IDEMPOTENT (lid=X*1e6+Y deterministic). Disjoint from parallax_lift (persp==1).
